# Phase-4 argument-map validator — top-level dependency intent.
#
# This file is the human-readable pin; `requirements-lock.txt` is the
# install source of truth. The lockfile is generated by:
#
#     skills/lit-review-argument/.venv/bin/pip-compile \
#         --generate-hashes \
#         --output-file requirements-lock.txt \
#         requirements.txt
#
# Validate-argument-map.sh installs from `requirements-lock.txt` with
# `pip install --require-hashes --no-deps`, so the entire transitive tree
# is pinned by hash. Bump the top-level pin below, regenerate the lock,
# and commit both files together.
#
# Why pin to a commit SHA: argdown-feedback (DebateLab @ KIT, AGPL-3.0)
# cuts no PyPI releases. The Git pin + hashed lock together give us
# reproducible, supply-chain-controlled installs. See ADR-055's
# "Argdown validator migration (#1045)" section.
argdown-feedback @ git+https://github.com/debatelab/argdown-feedback@0bd882ea1a2ad1ec8f375d7afb69ef4ee51b97cb
